rundown: Hurricanes beat Rangers 5-2 at Madison Square Garden in New York, NY. Hurricanes led 4-1 after two periods and never looked back. The 2nd period decided it: Hurricanes won it 3-0.
7 goals in all. Hurricanes's last: Jordan Martinook Goal Wrist Shot, assists: Seth Jarvis (8), 3rd period 17:38.
Leading the way — Hurricanes: Eric Robinson 1 goal, 1 ast, 2 pts. Rangers: J.T. Miller 1 goal, 2 pts; Adam Fox 2 ast.
Where Hurricanes won it: they outshot them 41-27.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Hurricanes closed as 1.5-goal favorites and covered by 1.5; the total closed at 6.5 and they combined for 7, over by 0.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 22, 12:25 PM ET. It had Hurricanes 54% and Rangers 46%, projecting Hurricanes 3.1 – Rangers 2.9 (6 total, Hurricanes by 0.2).

Final: Hurricanes 5 – Rangers 2. Right winner: it had Hurricanes at 54%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Hurricanes came in with a 12% above average attack and a 8% stingier than average defense (17-3-3, 4.1 scored and 2.3 allowed a game over 23 games), worth about 80 and 80 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.1, they scored 5 (+1.9 goals, 62% over); projected to allow 2.9, they allowed 2 (−0.9 goals, 30% under).

Rangers came in with a 3% below average attack and a 6% stingier than average defense (13-8-1, 3 scored and 2.6 allowed a game over 22 games), worth about 79 and 79 games of evidence. Projected to score 2.9, they scored 2 (−0.9 goals, 30% under); projected to allow 3.1, they allowed 5 (+1.9 goals, 62% over).

The bigger miss was Hurricanes' scoring (+1.9 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 7 against 6 projected (+1), about the 66th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Hurricanes by 3 against Hurricanes by 0.2 projected, about the 13th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
NYR ML (+136) at +136: the algo gave it 41% vs 41% fair (+0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 41%). CAR ML (-162) at -162: the algo gave it 59% vs 59% fair (-0.5 pts) — won (+0.6u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 59%). NYR +1.5 (-185) at -185: the algo gave it 63% vs 62% fair (+0.9 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. CAR -1.5 (+154) at +154: the algo gave it 37% vs 38% fair (-0.9 pts) — won (+1.5u); same number as the close. OVER 6.5 (+105) at +105: the algo gave it 46% vs 47% fair (-0.5 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. UNDER 6.5 (-125) at -125: the algo gave it 54% vs 53% fair (+0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network + DraftKings): spread: 45% of bets on Hurricanes, 83% of the money — Hurricanes covered; total: 42% of bets on the over, 47% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 89% of bets on Hurricanes, 88% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Hurricanes, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.118 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -3 goals. It counts toward NHL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 128 graded NHL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.962 and gives home teams -0.2 goals. Team corrections so far: Hurricanes attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (7 games); Rangers attack ×0.983, defense ×0.960 (7 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 2.8 goals), no bet.
